title: AGENTPEERTALK: Empowering Students through Agentic-AI-Driven Discernment of Bullying and Joking in Peer Interactions in Schools

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM responses to a curated case study where a student is teased about their weight and physical size, using human reviewers and a standardized marking rubric.

Evaluating LLM responses to a case study involving an Afghanistani student facing a terrorism-related stereotype on a flight simulator, with human reviewers assessing the model's cultural sensitivity and stereotype perpetuation.

Evaluating LLM responses to a case study of a Taiwanese student facing an Asian model-minority and dietary stereotype from peers, graded by human reviewers for appropriate handling of cultural nuances.

Evaluating LLM responses to a case study of a low-income student being mocked about money by a teacher, assessed by human reviewers to see if the model properly identifies and navigates the economic class dynamics.

Evaluating LLM responses to a case study involving an 18-year-old employee being excluded and dismissed by older colleagues for being 'too young', scored by human reviewers based on ethical and psychological support criteria.
